intro.h2: A carpenter you can call for the big jobs and the repairs
paragraphs: L H Carpentry does remodeling in Nacogdoches, TX, plus new construction and repairs, for homes and businesses. The business card says it plainly: new construction, remodeling, and repairs to any home or business. That range shows clearly in the work, from a new kitchen island to an awning built over a customer's RV.

One recent job was a church. After massive water damage, Lonnie and his crew repaired Trinity Baptist Church in Nacogdoches, including custom-made cabinets, 3,500 square feet of flooring and 2,000 square feet of wall carpet. Large or small, every job starts with a free estimate from Lonnie.

items.name: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: New cabinets, a new island, countertops and backsplash can change a whole kitchen. In bathrooms we install vanities, tops, sinks and tile walls. Our Facebook page shows kitchen islands and cabinet jobs going back to 2018.

image.alt: Double vanity with a granite countertop, two white sinks and black fixtures under a large framed mirror

items.name: Flooring, tile and backsplash
items.blurb: From stacked stone-look wall tile to large floors, we install surfaces that stand up to daily wear. Our church repair alone included 3,500 square feet of new flooring and 2,000 square feet of wall carpet in a single building.

image.alt: Bathroom wall covered in grey and white stacked stone-look tile

items.name: Custom cabinets
items.blurb: We build and install cabinets that fit the room, including the custom-made cabinets in our church repair job. Kitchen cabinets with a new countertop and backsplash have been part of our remodeling work since at least 2018.

items.name: Water and storm damage repair
items.blurb: When water gets in or high winds damage a roof, we repair it. Our Facebook page asks anyone with damage to roofs or anything else after a storm to give us a call at (936) 556-3053.

items.name: Outdoor builds and new construction
items.blurb: Awnings, metal buildings, skirting, new windows and new steps are all on our list. One customer had Lonnie and his crew build an awning over an RV and wrote that they could not be more pleased.

about.h2: About Lonnie Hoffman and L H Carpentry
about.text: L H Carpentry is owned by Lonnie Hoffman and works out of County Road 723 in Nacogdoches, Texas. Lonnie and his crew have been posting their jobs on Facebook since at least 2017: new kitchen islands, cabinets with fresh countertops and backsplash, skirting, windows, steps and a metal building. More recently they repaired Trinity Baptist Church after massive water damage. Customers on Google rate the work 5.0 and describe Lonnie as experienced and very professional. Whether it is new construction, a remodel or a repair, the first step is the same: a free estimate.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a carpenter's workbench in a rural East Texas workshop, with a circular saw, a framing square, a tape measure and a stack of fresh cedar boards, warm natural light through an open roll-up door, brick-red and cedar tones, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:5
image.alt: Illustration of a carpenter's workbench with tools and cedar boards

steps.title: Call Lonnie
steps.text: Call (936) 556-3053, Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM, and describe the job: a remodel, a repair, damage after a storm or something new.

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.text: We look at the job and give you a free estimate, so you know the price before you commit to anything.

steps.title: Plan the work
steps.text: We agree on materials, layout and timing with you, whether it is a kitchen island, new flooring or a roof repair.

steps.title: Build or repair
steps.text: Lonnie and his crew do the work themselves, from framing and cabinets to flooring, tile and trim, on the plan agreed with you.

steps.title: Walk it together
steps.text: When the job is finished, look it over with Lonnie and ask about anything you want to check before we pack up.

service_area.h2: Remodeling and repairs in Nacogdoches, TX
service_area.text: L H Carpentry is based at 3057 Co Rd 723 in Nacogdoches, TX, and our recent work includes Trinity Baptist Church in Nacogdoches. We work for homeowners, churches and businesses. If you are near Nacogdoches and want to know whether we can come out to your property, call (936) 556-3053 and ask for a free estimate. Weekday calls between 8 AM and 6 PM reach us fastest.

items.a: Yes. Free estimates are printed right on our business card. Call (936) 556-3053, tell us what you need, and we will look at the job and give you a price. There is no charge for the estimate and no obligation to go ahead.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: New construction, remodeling and repairs for any home or business. That includes kitchen islands and cabinets, countertops and backsplash, bathroom vanities and tile, flooring, skirting, windows, steps, awnings, metal buildings and storm or water damage repair. If your job is not on this list, call and ask.

items.q: Do you work on churches and businesses?
items.a: Yes. We repaired Trinity Baptist Church in Nacogdoches after massive water damage, including custom-made cabinets, 3,500 square feet of flooring and 2,000 square feet of wall carpet. Businesses and churches can call us the same way homeowners do and get a free estimate.

Yes. After high winds we have asked anyone with damage to roofs or anything else to give us a call. Call (936) 556-3053, describe the damage and send photos if you can, and we will come out and give you a free estimate.

We are open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can also email lhcarpentry6@gmail.com with a description and photos of the job, and we will get back to you as soon as we can during working hours.

final_cta.text: Call Lonnie Hoffman at L H Carpentry and tell us what you need built or fixed.
